subject.title: fix(xai): gate server-side tools to xAI models only

question: Should xAI-billed `code_execution` and `x_search` be hidden whenever active-model provider metadata is missing or non-xAI, or should intentional cross-provider use stay available behind an explicit opt-in?
rationale: The fail-closed behavior matches the plugin docs for sensitive model-adaptive tools, but it can hide tools for existing sessions or callers that currently omit `modelProvider`.

options.title: Accept fail-closed default
options.body: Treat missing or non-xAI active-model metadata as unsuitable for xAI-billed tools, then require tests and current proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve cross-provider use by opt-in
options.body: Add a documented explicit allowlist or config path before changing the default for existing cross-provider workflows.

options.title: Defer to canonical issue
options.body: Leave this PR unmerged and resolve the broader opt-in and billing policy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97621.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed default
recommendation.body: Treat missing or non-xAI active-model metadata as unsuitable for xAI-billed tools, then require tests and current proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete appears in the active-model plugin-context history and repeated xAI provider/plugin work relevant to the policy choice.
